name: RBY MMO
description: Play Kanto with friends: shared overworld presence, nicknames over other players' heads, corner toasts for chat, arrivals and what your party member just fought, a scoped chat box, a per-hub friends list that remembers people between sessions, parties of two, co-op 2-on-2 battles, ranked PVP scored by the hub, and trade or battle requests from anywhere in the world.
